docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,100.00 FILED BY ZIARNEK, MICHAEL ARTHUR AS TO DEFENDANT RICHARDSON, MEREDITH ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-10-1994 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 00
